title: RISE Live: the face
acceptance: The approved study (docs/assets/live/sophia-face-study.html, version 6) is ported faithfully as a native engine, `oracle` (src/scenes/engines/oracle.js), run in the scene worker like every scene: the central eye (three layers of 36 petals drifting at their own paces, core-to-iris colours, a breathing pupil that narrows with the pointer's nearness, a catchlight set against the gaze), seven orbiting pulsing nodes, the 24-line spiral field, the torus built once per size (48 by 24), phi recursion circles to depth 3, the trail in the skin's dark; geometry, colours and timings unchanged.

The blink is the eye's own geometry closing like a flower: layers fold outer to inner (220 ms in, 70 ms hold, 360 ms out, 1.2 times slower while thinking), petals draw in to 8% reach twisting, the pupil to a point, the catchlight fades, a seed of light where the petals meet, and beneath them a socket in the room's near-black and nine S-curved shutter blades in the iris's palette, turning a few degrees; no lids, no concentric rings; every 4 to 8 s.

Five states eased with a 0.18 s time constant (arrival, listening, thinking, speaking withdrawn at presence 0.22, rest) and four skins (Sophia, Ember, Jade, Silver), exactly as the study's STATES and SKINS; the gaze follows the reader's pointer eased (about 0.35 s) and clamped; reduced motion: no orbit, drift or blink, and every state at once. The face listens to the pointer only and emits nothing: no rise.emit, no perception, no journal entry.

Within the frame budget and the flash gate (a blink does not trip it), with the pixel ratio capped at 2; a still SVG face is shown before the worker's first frame and as the poster, and cross-fades out (about 400 ms) once the engine has drawn; neither the engine nor the still is in the first load.

The venue owns the face as its own scene layer, never injected into a reading's Current: arrival at idle; listening while the reader types or the microphone listens; thinking from the ask until the reading's first words are shown (the real pending request, no timer); withdrawn (speaking, then hidden, cross-faded about 600 ms) once the reading's first words are shown, the reading's canvas never resized at the hand-off; forward again over a held reading for an interjection (listening, then thinking while asked) and withdrawn as the answer comes; rest when a reading ends or a question fails.

Settings in the venue only offers Face (Sophia, Ember, Jade, Silver), kept as the `liveFace` setting, default Sophia; the theme does not change it and the model never does (no room change kind for it). The card, the Worker, the tool text and Composer's guide are unchanged; `oracle` is not in the model-facing engine list.
